(#1)
  TITLE: Eve of the War [from War of the Worlds] (3:35-3:54)
 ARTIST: Jeff Wayne
COMMENT: Made famous by the We M.U.S.I.C. movie demo, titled "The Gladiator",
         which featured a drummer drumming to rhythm in the lower left corner
         of the screen, and showed a movie in the upper right.
